about:
# Lorekeeper's Codex: Lore of Azeroth

Lorekeeper's Codex adds a book of Azeroth's lore that fills in as you explore.
Visit Kharanos, speak with King Magni, defeat a Frostmane troll or finish a
quest, and you might discover a page about the history behind it. Each page
is an original text written as a note from Archesonus, Royal Historian of
Ironforge. A Horde character's copy comes from Parqual Fintallas, a historian
of the Undercity, who adds notes of his own in the margins.

The Codex has **441 pages in 44 chapters**, or **456 pages in 46 chapters on
Forever**. It covers the original world's zones, landmarks, figures, peoples,
classes and history. Each race gets its own foreword.

For Classic Era, Hardcore, Season of Discovery and World of
Warcraft: Forever. One download covers all of them. See
[FOREVER.md](https://github.com/salty-max/lorekeepers-codex/blob/main/FOREVER.md) for Forever support.

## In game

Type `/codex` or click the minimap button to read. Browse by chapter, search
your discovered pages or filter by type. Related pages link to each other.
Your characters share one codex, with the date, level and location of every
discovery: a page one of them found is there on the others, marked, and the
Pages list can show just those. A Hardcore character keeps a codex of its own.
Undiscovered pages stay hidden.

Pages unlock by exploring, meeting people, defeating creatures, finishing
quests, gaining reputation and reading books or inscriptions. A chat link,
an alert and a sound announce each discovery. Tooltips point out creatures
and players who can unlock a page.

The lore covers the world's past up to the original game, using Warcraft I
to III, WoW's quests and books, and the novels and histories about that
period. Later expansion events and answers to mysteries left open in the
original game are kept out. The Codex reads in English and
French. Other clients get English,
with the places and the Library's titles in their own language. Most unlocks
use game ids, and reading-based unlocks
recognise titles in every client language. Where you found a page is kept by
the game's ids, so it follows your client's language, even after you switch.

On Forever, kill-based unlocks work in the open world. Creatures inside
dungeons and raids are hidden from addons, so kills there cannot unlock pages.
Some pages, paragraphs and unlocks differ between Classic and Forever.

## Library and achievements

The **Library** saves the books, notes, quest letters and plaques you read
in the world. Texts are copied in full, with where and when you found them,
so you can return to a quest letter after handing it in. Letters written by
players are never copied. The top of the shelves brings back the Library at a
glance: what each shelf holds and the texts copied lately.

The **Achievements** tab tracks page milestones, completed chapters, Library
progress, notable encounters and feats. Each achievement records the day
and level you earned it, and your characters share them (a Hardcore character keeps its own). Open the tab with `/codex achievements`.

## Settings and commands

The welcome page appears once per character. Use `/codex welcome` to see it
again. Settings are under **Options > AddOns > Lorekeeper's Codex**, through
`/codex settings` or by right-clicking the minimap button.

Choose the alerts for new pages and for achievements, their duration,
sounds, tooltip hints, the missing pages (a greyed row for each page not found), the book's size (four steps), the paper colours (dark ink on tan paper, applied by a reload: the page ends with a Reload button) and the minimap button (chat lines always show). **Options > Key Bindings** lists **Open Lorekeeper's Codex**: one key, or on Forever a controller button, opens and closes the book. Each character has its own settings. Copy another
character's settings in the same game, or transfer them with `/codex export`
and `/codex import CODE`.

- `/codex minimap` shows or hides the minimap button. Drag it to move it.
- `/codex banner` toggles page alerts.
- `/codex reset` clears what this character found itself after confirmation.
  The shared codex keeps every page.
- `/codex where` prints your position and target for writing new pages.
- `/codex account` prints what this character and the shared codex hold (English only, for finding out why another character's pages are missing).
- `/codex scan on` records areas, creatures, quest texts and books to help
  write Forever content. `scripts/scan-export.lua` converts the saved data
  to JSON.

Known Library texts also follow your client's language (English and French
for now). Original game wording is used where available, with documented
translations for missing bodies. Unrecognised copies stay as recorded.

The full store description is in [addon/CURSEFORGE.md](https://github.com/salty-max/lorekeepers-codex/blob/main/addon/CURSEFORGE.md).
The review ledgers of October 2026 (the lore review, the voice review, the
German review) were removed on 30 October 2026, all in git's history.

## Writing pages

Pages live in `content/<chapter>/<id>.md`:

```markdown
---
id: kharanos
title: Kharanos
kind: place          # place | figure | faction | creature | history | note | calling
unlock:              # any one of these unlocks it
  - area: Kharanos   # zone or sub-zone, by name (data/areas.json)
  - npc: 2784        # talking to (or targeting) this creature
  - kill: 706, 946   # killing one of these creatures (your blow or your pet's)
  - quest: 1234      # turning in this quest (or having done it)
  - reputation: 47 friendly
  - position: 1455 57 47 6   # uiMap, x %, y %, radius %
  - people: Dwarf    # a player of this race met (targeted), or one's own
  - calling: MAGE    # a player of this class met (targeted), or one's own
  - read: Aegwynn and the Dragon Hunt   # reading this book or plaque, in any language (data/texts.json)
  - [classic] area: Timbermaw Hold (Azshara)   # an unlock on one game only
also: [war-of-the-three-hammers]
client: forever      # optional: on this game only (forever or classic)
---
Paragraphs separated by blank lines. *A paragraph in asterisks is a signature.*

[forever] A paragraph starting with [forever] or [classic] shows on that game only.
```

`bun scripts/build.ts` checks ids, unlock rules, links and place names, then
writes `Content_Classic.lua` and `Content_Forever.lua`.

After adding a `read:` unlock, run `python3 scripts/texts.py` to update the
book's objects and translated titles in `data/texts.json`. After adding a
portrait, run `python3 scripts/portraits.py`.

## Development

```bash
bun run build      # Build Content_Classic.lua and Content_Forever.lua
bun run check      # Check Lua, generated files and simulations on both games
bun run package    # Create dist/LorekeepersCodex-<version>.zip
```

`scripts/release.sh NOTES.md` runs the release checks, tags and pushes.
GitHub Actions uses the BigWigs packager to publish
`LorekeepersCodex-vX.Y.Z.zip` on GitHub, CurseForge and Wago Addons.

## License

releases.notes:
Lorekeeper's Codex 0.17.0

- New: one codex for the whole account. Your characters share their pages, tunes, read marks and the Library's texts, and a page one of them found is there on the others. The Pages list marks the pages this character has not found itself and can show just those. A Hardcore character keeps a codex of its own, apart from the shared one.
- Achievements are shared across the account too, and shown in the game's alert once. A Hardcore character keeps its own.
- New: the **Missing pages** option adds a greyed row for each page you have not found, with no title, text or place, and lists the chapters you have not started by name and page count alone. It is off by default.
- New: `/codex account` prints what this character and the shared codex hold, in English, for finding out why another character's pages are missing.
- Fixed: a title read after the account's library began still unlocks its page at a catch-up.
- New: **Book size** makes the whole window larger, in four steps from Normal to Largest, and **Paper colours** show dark ink on tan paper instead of the dark look. Both are in the settings. Paper colours apply after a reload, and the settings page now ends with a Reload button and a line saying so.
- New: a key binding. **Options > Key Bindings** lists **Open Lorekeeper's Codex** under a heading of its own, so one key, or on Forever a controller button, opens and closes the book. Nothing is bound until you choose.
- On Forever, the window now tells the Gamepad UI that it is open, so a controller's D-pad can move across its buttons.
- On Forever with the Gamepad UI on, the game can show its blocked-action popup after an options page opens. That is a bug in the game's own Gamepad UI. A reload clears it, and the settings page now says so.
- The game's data is brought up to date.

Lorekeeper's Codex 0.16.0

- New: the soundtrack. The tunes of the game's music are found where they play and played again, with a page for why each place sounds as it does. Waves cover the lands, inns, keeps, battlegrounds, raids, dungeons, Zephras Isle and Forever's new dungeons.
- A pass over the lore pages: spoilers cut, pages end on their fact, spelling and pronouns fixed.
- French is finished, with the game's own names by id and the client's spacing before : ? ! and percent signs.
- The interface is in English and French. German and Spanish stay English for now.

The family's look, second pass
- The forewords are signed in the same voice as the chapters and the letters, no longer a paragraph of their own.
- The addon's name in chat wears the theme's accent, and the tooltip uses the family's two inks.
- The achievement sound is a choice of its own, and the alert banner's time is a setting.
- The book opens where you left it.
- Area names refreshed from the game's data.

Lorekeeper's Codex 0.15.1

- **Latin American Spanish names** now come from the game's own data, with Spanish from Spain filling in where the Latin American client has none. The Windsor pair keeps its documented exception.
- The reset line says "confirm" properly in French, German and Spanish, and the Spanish import prompt asks for a CODE, not a CÓDIGO.

Lorekeeper's Codex 0.15.0

- **28 new pages.** The paladin's charger and the warlock's dreadsteeds, the chromatic flight, Natalia Mar'alith, Lar'korwi, Zanzil the Outcast, the Felstones, the goblins, the elementals, the lost dwarves of the Badlands and more, in English, French, German and Spanish. 441 pages across the original world.
- **Shen'dralas on Forever.** A new chapter for the cursed country that begins at the Valley of Bones, and a page on the Wetlands' excavation site. 456 pages on Forever.
- **No ending told too early.** A page that tells how a story ends now waits until you reach that ending, after an audit of the pages tied to quests. Dartol's Rod, Kalaran Windblade, Zamael Lunthistle and the Winterfall firewater are among those that moved.
- **Franclorn Forgewright without dying.** Only the dead see his ghost, so his page also opens when you target Fineous Darkvire or deal his killing blow.
